Name: Agricultural Company
Author: Saebyeol
Description: Production UI visual-fidelity release: keeps the 0.8.4 management layout and overlays authored pixel-art machinery, process, product, timber and parchment assets for a richer farm-company look. Replaces mixed-language catalog titling, preserves safe visual fallbacks if external assets are missing, and keeps vanilla-crop production, optional Crop Genetics integration, quality/yield, contracts, brand progression, save compatibility, and equal-partner multiplayer.
